item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a strong 2024 source showing broad, economy-wide gains in wages, jobs, schooling continuity, or health access that would clearly outweigh the macro and rights deterioration. Most positives were either pre-2024 baseline facts, partner-led humanitarian programs, or reform design rather than demonstrated nationwide outcomes.","evidence":[{"title":"Bangladesh: remarkable development progress, but still with structural gaps","publisher":"World Bank","date":"December 31, 2023 / disclosed January 2, 2024","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099514001022413953","summary":"The World Bank described lower-middle-income status, gender parity in school enrollment, and large mortality reductions. This is the clearest baseline evidence that Hasina inherited and then governed over a society with materially better life chances than decades earlier, though it is not a 2024 improvement by itself.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9"]},{"title":"Bangladesh already had cash-transfer programs for the poorest","publisher":"World Bank","date":"January 1, 2024","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099739201032424234","summary":"The project profile notes cash transfers for widows, older people, and disabled people, with modernization aimed at better targeting and transparency. That is limited positive evidence that benefits were at least partly needs-based rather than patronage-only.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.7","6B.8"]},{"title":"Bangladesh receives $900 million to increase resilience and reform","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 21, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/21/bangladesh-receives-900-million-world-bank-financing-to-increase-economic-and-urban-resilience-for-sustainable-growth","summary":"The Bank backed fiscal and financial-sector reforms, tax changes, procurement reform, and climate-resilient urban management. This points to a real attempt to protect long-run life chances, but it is reform intent more than proven outcome.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"Bangladesh develops Bay Terminal to cut trade costs","publisher":"World Bank","date":"June 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/28/world-bank-helps-bangladesh-develop-bay-terminal","summary":"The Bay Terminal project was framed as a way to reduce import/export costs, improve port efficiency, and mobilize private investment. That supports a pro-opportunity reading, though it is infrastructure planning rather than demonstrated broad welfare gain in 2024.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"Medical education strategy launched with WHO support","publisher":"WHO Bangladesh","date":"March 4, 2024","url":"https://www.who.int/bangladesh/news/detail/04-03-2024-advancing-healthcare-excellence-who-s-role-in-developing-the-first-national-medical-education-strategy-in-bangladesh","summary":"The health ministry launched a national medical education strategy built on workforce studies and technical working group work. This is a genuine institutional investment in future life chances, but it is narrow and does not offset the broader 2024 macro deterioration.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.8"]},{"title":"Second JEE used a formal evidence platform","publisher":"WHO","date":"July 11, 2024","url":"https://www.who.int/southeastasia/news/detail/11-07-2024-2nd-jee-bn","summary":"Bangladesh completed a peer-reviewed Joint External Evaluation using a formal platform that identified strengths, gaps, and priority actions. This is real capacity-building that could improve future life chances, but again it is sector-specific.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.9","6B.5"]},{"title":"Rohingya and host-community support","publisher":"World Bank","date":"May 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/05/28/world-bank-helps-bangladesh-provide-basic-services-opportunities-and-build-resilience-for-displaced-rohingya-and-host-co","summary":"World Bank-backed projects funded health, nutrition, education, water, shelters, livelihood support, and GBV prevention for Rohingya and host communities, with attention to women and children. This is one of the clearest positive items for vulnerable groups, but it is humanitarian and externally financed.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Targeted disaster and inclusion services","publisher":"UNFPA Bangladesh","date":"2024","url":"https://bangladesh.unfpa.org/en/unfpa-bangladesh-annual-report-2024","summary":"UNFPA reported services for women, girls, persons with disabilities, transgender people, sex workers, indigenous communities, and disaster-affected areas, including emergency reproductive health and cash assistance. That is strong evidence of some life-chance protection for vulnerable groups.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Inflation and reserve pressure eroded purchasing power","publisher":"World Bank","date":"April 2, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/02/financial-sector-and-fiscal-policy-reforms-will-help-bangladesh-sustain-strong-growth-despite-strong-growth-south-asia-r","summary":"The Bank said inflation eroded purchasing power, reserves were under pressure, and reforms were needed. Even with growth momentum, the 2024 macro environment was not improving ordinary people’s life chances cleanly.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5"]},{"title":"Economy weakened under Hasina in 2024","publisher":"Reuters","date":"August 8, 2024","url":"https://m.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/factboxtroubled-bangladeshs-economy-bogged-down-by-high-unemployment-inflation-3561503?ampMode=1","summary":"Reuters summarized widening external deficits, taka depreciation, falling reserves, IMF dependence, and stagnant private-sector job creation. That is direct evidence against a year in which ordinary people’s prospects broadly improved.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.4","6B.7"]},{"title":"Extreme poverty and inequality were projected to rise","publisher":"World Bank","date":"October 1, 2024","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099659510152422672","summary":"The Bank projected slower growth, rising extreme poverty, and more than one Gini point of higher inequality, with jobs and revenue mobilization still unresolved. This undercuts any claim that 2024 left ordinary people on a clearly better trajectory.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.7"]},{"title":"Crackdown denied care and increased impunity","publisher":"UN OHCHR","date":"July 26, 2024","url":"https://bangladesh.un.org/en/275065-bangladesh-t%C3%BCrk-decries-government-crackdown-urges-respect-international-human-rights","summary":"The UN said more than 170 people were killed, some injured people were denied medical care, and internet shutdowns increased impunity. That is very strong evidence that 2024 did not protect ordinary people’s life chances in the middle of crisis.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8"]},{"title":"Protests were met with curfew and shutdowns","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 20, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/bangladesh-army-enforces-curfew-as-student-led-protests-spiral/2182818/","summary":"Reuters described a nationwide curfew, internet/text shutdowns, and army deployment as violence escalated. That is evidence of coercive control and information suppression, not of improving the conditions ordinary people need to build better lives.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.8"]},{"title":"Hasina blamed opponents instead of correcting course","publisher":"Reuters","date":"July 22, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/bangladesh-pm-hasina-blames-opposition-for-violence-curfew-to-remain-3528153","summary":"Hasina kept the curfew in place and blamed political opponents for the violence. That is weak evidence of responsible stewardship and strong evidence against a leadership style that improves life chances through accountability.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.5","6B.8"]},{"title":"Deadliest crackdown in recent history","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"August 26, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/08/26/bangladesh-back-un-investigation-grave-abuses","summary":"HRW said the crackdown was the deadliest in Bangladesh’s recent history, with at least 440 killed and many injured. That is powerful evidence that ordinary people ended 2024 less safe, not more secure.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8"]},{"title":"Minorities and refugees still faced discrimination","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/bangladesh/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House said Rohingya had limited access to health care, employment, and education; minorities faced discrimination; and women were socially and politically disadvantaged. That directly cuts against broader life chances improving for everyone.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.7","6B.9"]},{"title":"Ethnic minorities in the CHT lived in fear","publisher":"Reuters","date":"September 21, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/fears-grip-ethnic-minorities-after-deadly-violence-in-bangladesh-3626672","summary":"Reuters reported homes and businesses burned and families displaced despite heavy patrols. This is direct evidence that poor regions and minorities were not protected well enough for life chances to improve.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.6","6B.8"]},{"title":"Repression already chilled the year at the start","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"January 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/bangladesh-repression-security-force-abuses-discredit-elections","summary":"HRW reported arrests for criticism and repression before the election. A year that starts with intimidation and fear is not a strong case for improved life chances.","question_ids":["6B.10","6B.8","6B.9"]}]}
